attestation.note: Live status is last-known and attested by hand. The health probe is not yet automated. Verdikt's production Nebius deploy is deferred to mid-Nov 2026 by design; a hackathon-scoped deploy is cut earlier from the same runbook.

readiness.one_liner: Everything the deploy runbook needs before we touch the Nebius console has been drafted, smoke-tested, or pre-flighted. Deploy-time items unlock when the VM comes up.

categories.name: Runbook & configuration
categories.description: Documented and pre-flighted before the VM comes up. Ready today.

items.name: Deploy runbook complete
items.detail: 12 sections including provisioning, TLS, verification, and rotation.

items.name: .env template shipped
items.detail: All production knobs represented: session/webhook/download secrets, admin hash, provider config, HSTS.

items.name: Production compose file
items.detail: web + worker + migrate sidecar + Postgres + Redis + MinIO. Migrations must exit 0 before web/worker start.

items.name: Caddy TLS reverse-proxy template
items.detail: Caddyfile drafted for `quire.<domain>` on :443 with zstd/gzip encoding and query-token redaction.

items.name: Local prod-mode smoke test
items.detail: Full docker-compose.prod stack brought up on laptop against a stub provider; /health returns 200; mapping wizard works.

categories.name: Application health
categories.description: Behavioural guarantees the deploy relies on. Verified in tests and locally.

items.name: /health endpoint
items.detail: Liveness endpoint returns 200 with a JSON body once the migrate sidecar exits and the web process is up.

items.name: Version-freeze byte-identical
items.detail: Two consecutive renders of the same input JSON must produce byte-identical version_hash. Enforced in tests.

items.name: Admin auth (bcrypt)
items.detail: DOCGEN_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH generated with hash_password(); no plaintext at rest.

items.name: Nemotron reasoning path (contract)
items.detail: Provider adapter tested against a Nebius Token Factory contract fixture; default model name must start with `nvidia/`.

items.name: Retriever + reranker warm-up
items.detail: pgvector store seeded from rules/*.yaml at startup; NIM endpoints reachable check happens on first retrieve() call, not at boot.

items.name: Boundary tests (AI vs render)
items.detail: docgen.core never imports docgen.providers; pap_pipeline never imports docgen. Enforced mechanically.

items.name: License audit gate
items.detail: CI job fails the build if a non-permissive third-party licence lands.

categories.name: Infrastructure
categories.description: Deploy-time actions on the Nebius console and DNS. Blocked on the mid-Nov deploy date.

items.name: Nebius VM provisioned
items.detail: Ubuntu 24.04, 4 vCPU / 8 GB / 40 GB disk. Region close to Token Factory endpoint. Public IPv4 enabled.

items.name: DNS A-record pointing to VM
items.detail: `quire.<domain>` → VM public IPv4. Must propagate before Caddy starts or ACME will retry hourly.

items.name: Security group (:22 / :80 / :443)
items.detail: :80 required for Let's Encrypt ACME HTTP-01 challenge; :443 for public HTTPS; :22 restricted to admin IPs.

items.name: Docker Engine + Compose installed
items.detail: One-line install from get.docker.com; deploy user added to docker group.

items.name: Nebius Token Factory API key
items.detail: Issued at studio.nebius.com. Copied once (not retrievable). Spend cap set in console.

items.name: TLS certificate (Let's Encrypt via Caddy)
items.detail: 90-day auto-renewing cert. First issuance triggered on first HTTPS request after DNS propagates.

categories.name: Security & operations
categories.description: Hardening controls the runbook applies before rotating credentials and handing out the URL.

items.name: HSTS + secure-cookies flags
items.detail: DOCGEN_SECURE_COOKIES=true, DOCGEN_HSTS_ENABLED=true in the .env template; enforced by the app when set.

items.name: Trusted-proxies + public-base-url
items.detail: DOCGEN_TRUSTED_PROXIES=127.0.0.1 (Caddy on the same host); DOCGEN_PUBLIC_BASE_URL set for absolute link building.

items.name: .env file permissions 600
items.detail: chmod 600 .env owned by deploy user only. Enforced on the VM at bring-up.

items.name: Credential rotation before demo
items.detail: Session secret, admin password hash, and Token Factory key all rotated in the final 24-hour window before recording the video.

live.one_liner: Nothing is running in production yet. This section becomes the operational dashboard the moment the Nebius VM boots.

services.name: Web (docgen)
services.role: FastAPI app: admin UI + inbox + pipeline
services.detail: Awaits Nebius VM provisioning (target 2026-10-25 hackathon-scoped, 2026-11-15 production).

services.name: Worker
services.detail: Runs in the same docker-compose stack as web; scales independently.

services.name: Postgres
services.detail: Migrations run by a sidecar container before web/worker start.

services.name: MinIO (object store)
services.role: Rendered PDFs, source PDFs, extracted assets
services.detail: S3-compatible. MINIO_ROOT_* rotated at deploy time.

services.name: Caddy (TLS reverse proxy)
services.detail: Provisioned on the VM host (not in compose) so the ACME challenge can bind :80 directly.

services.name: Nebius Token Factory
services.role: External: hosts Nemotron for the reasoning stage
services.detail: External API; verified reachable from a laptop with a scratch key on 2026-09-14. No production key issued yet.
